facts.fact: 遇到一个由冰组成、核心温度零下的人，结论是“看起来是个冰家伙”——ice guy 谐音 nice guy
facts.anchor: I’ve just met a man who appears to be made out of frozen water and has a core temperature of below 0 degrees Celsius. Seems like an ice guy.

facts.fact: 中子进酒吧点酒，问多少钱，酒保说“对你免费”——no charge 双关无电荷／不收费
facts.anchor: A neutron goes into a bar and orders a drink. ‘How much do I owe you?’ it asks. ‘For you?’ says the barman, ‘No charge.’

facts.fact: 科学家不信原子：它们构成一切（make up）又全是编造（make up）
facts.anchor: Why don’t scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.

facts.fact: 光子办登机，说没有行李：I’m travelling light，光子以光速旅行＋轻装
原子丢了电子，另一个问确定吗，它说“我确定”（正电／positive）
薛定谔的猫犯罪被通缉：死活同时成立（wanted dead or alive 被改成 dead and alive）
facts.anchor: Schrödinger’s Cat recently went on a crime spree and is now wanted dead and alive.

facts.fact: 平行线有那么多共同点，可惜永远不能相遇
facts.anchor: Parallel lines have so much in common. It’s a shame they’ll never meet.

facts.fact: 猎户座的腰带：浪费空间——waist（腰）谐音 waste
facts.anchor: Orion’s belt: what a waist of space.

facts.fact: 世上有 10 种人：懂二进制的和不懂的——10 在二进制里是 2
facts.anchor: There are 10 types of people in the world: those that understand binary and those that don’t.

facts.fact: 程序员把万圣节和圣诞节搞混：八进制 31 等于十进制 25
facts.anchor: Why do computer programmers mix up Halloween and Christmas? Because Oct 31 = Dec 25.
